page.help: Members earn points (XP) for chatting and go up in level as they collect more. You can post a message when someone levels up and give roles at certain levels. You can also change these with /level dashboard in Discord.

topic.earningLine: How fast members level up, and what Mewvo posts when they do.
topic.rewardsLine: Roles for reaching a level, and changing a level by hand.
topic.catLine: A cat that grows as members chat, from Kitten to Legend.

xp.title: XP and messages
xp.help: XP per message, the wait between XP, and the level-up message.
xp.minHelp: Each message gives a random amount of XP between these two numbers.
xp.cooldownHelp: A member gets XP for one message at most this often, so spamming does not level them up faster. In seconds.
xp.channelHelp: Where the level-up message is posted.
xp.announceHelp: Off: members still level up, but no message is posted.
xp.messageHelp: You can use {user} (mentions the member) and {level} (their new level).

card.title: Level-up card
card.help: An image with the level-up message.
card.more: Members can also see the same card with /rank card:True. Mewvo needs the Attach Files permission in the level-up channel; without it only the text is posted.
card.toggle: Add an image card to level-up messages
card.toggleHelp: The card shows the member's picture and name, the new level, a bar to the next level and the server name. Off: only the text message is posted. If the card cannot be made, the text message is posted on its own.
card.colourHelp: Used for the ring around the picture, the level and the bar.
card.hexHelp: A # and six letters or numbers. When filled in, it is used instead of the colour above.

boosts.title: XP boosts
boosts.help: More XP in some channels or for some roles, from x{min} to x{max}.
boosts.more: A thread counts as its channel. If a member has several boosted roles, only the highest role boost counts. Channel boost times role boost is never more than x{cap}.
boosts.empty: No boosts. Every channel and role earns normal XP.

ignored.title: No XP in
ignored.help: Members get no XP in these channels, and members with these roles get none at all. Useful for bot or spam channels.
ignored.empty: Members earn XP in every channel.

rewards.title: Role rewards
rewards.help: Members get these roles by themselves when they reach the level. Mewvo can only give roles below its own role in the role list, and it will not give roles with staff powers.
rewards.modeHelp: Keep all: members keep every reward role they reached. Only the highest: when a member reaches a new reward, Mewvo gives that role and takes off the lower reward roles.

member.title: Member levels
member.help: Change one member's level by hand. You can also do this with /level add, /level remove and /level set in Discord.
member.userIdHelp: The long number that identifies a member. In Discord, turn on Developer Mode, right-click the member and pick Copy User ID.
member.needsAdmin: To change a member's level you need the Administrator permission in this server.

cat.title: Server cat
cat.help: Its name, and whether Mewvo posts when it grows.
cat.more: Members see it with /cat view and on the website leaderboard. When it grows, Mewvo posts once in the level-up channel (if one is set).
cat.notLoaded: The cat could not be loaded right now (the database is not responding). Reload to try again.
cat.name: Name
cat.nameHelp: Letters, numbers and spaces. Other characters are left out.
cat.announce: Post in the level-up channel when the cat grows
cat.needsAdmin: You need the Administrator permission in this server to change the cat.

error.cardHex: Card colour: write a colour code like #9B59B6, or leave it empty and pick from the list.
error.minMax: Least XP per message cannot be more than Most XP per message.
error.roleMissing: Role: that role is not in the server.
error.memberMissing: That member is not in the server.
error.catName: Name: use letters, numbers and spaces.

action.catNamed: The server cat is now called {name}.
action.ignoreAdded: No XP there from now on.
action.notListed: It was not on the list.
action.noBoost: There was no boost for that.
action.modeHighest: Members now keep only their highest reward role. It applies to each member when they level up, and to everyone the next time Mewvo restarts.
action.modeKeep: Members now keep all their reward roles.
action.noReward: There was no reward for that level.
